bidder.description: Bidder claiming the NFT after timeout.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgClaimBid.title: Msg Claim Bid
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgClaimBid.description: MsgClaimBid allows bidder to claim NFT after bid timeout expires without acceptance. Behavior: - Allows bidder to claim NFT ownership after bid timeout. - Transfers escrowed bid amount to previous owner. - Transfers NFT ownership to bidder. - Updates NFT valuation to claimed bid amount. - Resets valuation expiry to bid timestamp. Validation: - NFT must have active bid. - Sender must be current bidder. - Bid timeout period must have elapsed since bid placement. Emits: - EventBidClaimed(class_id, nft_id, bidder) on successful claim. Returns: - Empty response on success.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgClaimBid.title: Msg Claim Bid Response
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgClaimBid.description: Empty response for successful bid claim.
